news.headline: Moderna Announces Late-Breaking Data to Be Presented at ESMO Congress 2026
news.summary: Moderna and Merck will present three abstracts on intismeran autogene at ESMO Congress 2026, including a Presidential Symposium slot on October 24 in Madrid for full Phase 3 INTerpath-001 melanoma data. The presentation follows August's headline readout showing the cancer vaccine combination reduced recurrence and metastasis risk versus Keytruda alone.

news.headline: Argus Research Upgrades Moderna to Buy, Sets $180 Price Target
news.summary: Argus raised Moderna from Hold to Buy, citing a now five-product approved portfolio spanning COVID-19, combination flu/COVID, RSV and influenza vaccines. The upgrade came amid a broader wave of sell-side optimism following the melanoma vaccine's Phase 3 success.

news.headline: Moderna Receives U.S. FDA Approval for Updated 2026-2027 COVID-19 Vaccines
news.summary: The FDA approved supplemental BLAs for updated 2026-2027 formulas of Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE containing the JN.1-lineage XFG subvariant. The shots are approved for higher-risk individuals across various age groups and all adults 65 and older, ahead of the fall respiratory season.

news.headline: Moderna and Merck's mRNA Cancer Vaccine Succeeds in Late-Stage Melanoma Trial
news.summary: The Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial showed intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157) plus Keytruda significantly improved recurrence-free and distant metastasis-free survival versus Keytruda alone in resected stage IIB-IV melanoma. Moderna shares surged dramatically on the news, reframing the company as an oncology player alongside its vaccine business.

news.headline: FDA Approves Moderna's mFLUSIVA, First mRNA-Based Flu Vaccine
news.summary: The FDA granted standard approval for adults 50-64 and accelerated approval for adults 65+ for mFLUSIVA (mRNA-1010), the first licensed influenza vaccine built on mRNA technology. Late-stage trial data showed it was roughly 27% more effective than a standard-dose flu shot in older adults.

catalysts.label: ESMO Presidential Symposium — full INTerpath-001 melanoma data
catalysts.detail: Moderna and Merck will present detailed Phase 3 results for intismeran autogene plus Keytruda in resected stage IIB-IV melanoma at the ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid, with an investor webcast the same day.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Moderna is expected to report third-quarter 2026 results and update full-year revenue and opex guidance; exact date not yet confirmed by the company.

catalysts.label: Regulatory filing for intismeran autogene + Keytruda in melanoma
catalysts.detail: Following the positive Phase 3 INTerpath-001 readout, Moderna and Merck plan to engage regulators on filing submissions, with management flagging the possibility of an accelerated review pathway.

catalysts.label: 2026-2027 respiratory vaccine season launch
catalysts.detail: Commercial uptake of the newly approved/updated portfolio — mFLUSIVA, mCombriax (flu/COVID combo), updated Spikevax/mNEXSPIKE, and mResvia — during the fall/winter season is a near-term revenue driver.

pulse: Moderna shares have rallied sharply over the past six weeks, driven by the Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial showing intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157) plus Merck's Keytruda significantly cut recurrence and metastasis risk in high-risk melanoma, repositioning Moderna as an mRNA oncology platform beyond vaccines. That momentum has been reinforced by a broadened five-product respiratory portfolio (COVID-19, flu, flu/COVID combo, RSV) following FDA approvals of mFLUSIVA and updated 2026-2027 Spikevax/mNEXSPIKE, plus cost discipline and sell-side upgrades. Full INTerpath-001 data at ESMO's October 24 Presidential Symposium, progress toward a melanoma regulatory filing, and Q3 earnings (expected late October) are the next catalysts to watch.
